name: Convert Experiences
summary: A/B, split-URL, multivariate and personalization testing for websites (a tracking script and visual editor) and Full Stack SDKs with feature flags, aimed at mid-market e-commerce and CRO agencies. For agents: a hosted MCP server of 45 tools that signs in by Convert OAuth, a 16-tool local npm MCP server keyed by an Application ID and Secret Key, and a REST API v2 with the same keys. Every surface needs an account first; plans start at $299 per month after a 15-day free trial that needs no credit card.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-09, re-run unchanged 2026-09-16: hosted MCP initialize with no token answers 401 (empty body; Bearer realm OAuth, scope convert.mcp; its authorization server advertises a registration endpoint, client_secret_basic/post and none). REST GET /api/v2/accounts, no header: 401.

jobs.summary: A/B, split-URL and multivariate experiences on web pages through the tracking script and visual editor, and server-side experiences through the Full Stack SDKs; over the MCP server an agent reads live experience and goal data and creates draft tests for review, with a human confirming activation.
